analysis: The experiment cleanly tested one hypothesis: appending the trusted selected_user_profile fields to the existing hour+user_gap FM feature stack. The outcome contradicts the expected gain. On standalone validation, primary dropped by -0.0007378 with a paired 95% CI of [-0.0014162, -0.0000372], which excludes zero, so the degradation is statistically supported for this parent. Secondary metrics moved in the same direction (GAUC_mean 0.67090, nDCG@5_mean 0.53737), and the run was rolled back. Slice diagnostics suggest the added static profile fields were not broadly helpful: gains appeared only for the lowest-history users and some more popular-item buckets, while medium/high-history users and multiple tabs degraded, with especially large negative deltas on tabs 2, 4, and 6. This means the curated prior from E002 did not transfer to this exact legal parent/runtime setting; the added user-profile crosses likely introduced noise or interacted poorly with the sparse current stack rather than improving within-user ordering.
next_lesson: Do not add static user-profile fields to the minimal hour+user_gap FM parent without a stronger supporting mechanism, because this refinement degrades validation in the current setting.
